occurrences.text: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
Wherefore hear the word of the Lord, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
